title.value: AN  ACT  to  amend  the  environmental  conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or  wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances
title.provenance: AN  ACT  to  amend  the  environmental  conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or  wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

status.provenance: AN  ACT  to  amend  the  environmental  conservation law, in relation to prohibiting the sale and distribution of anti-fogging sprays or  wipes containing perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances

pfas_definition.provenance: “Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances” or “PFAS substances” means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 2.  After  December  thirty-first,  two thousand twenty-six, no person shall sell or offer for sale in this state anti-fogging sprays or  wipes containing  perfluoroalkyl  and  polyfluoroalkyl  substances  as  intentionally added chemicals or that contain perfluoroalkyl and  polyfluoroalkyl substances at or above a level that the department shall establish in regulation.

exceptions.provenance: 3.  No person that sells or offers for sale any anti-fogging sprays or wipes shall be held in violation of this section if they can  show  that they  relied  in good faith on the written assurance of the manufacturer of such product that such product met the requirements of this  section. Such  written  assurance shall take the form of a certificate of compliance stating that such product is in compliance with the requirements of this section. The certificate of compliance shall be signed by an authorized official of the manufacturer.
